name: Dimensions of Success
purpose: A visual aid to summarize the priorities, requirements, and criteria among stakeholders for an initiative or solution.
whereUsed: The Dimensions of Success is best used in the Problem Space during the Awareness Phase (1.0) to “Set the Context”. It’s also useful in the Solution Space to confirm relevance.
why: We will reduce and avoid the waste of time and resources that result from a lack of agreement among stakeholders.
outcomes: Disclosure of key business priorities, requirements, success criteria
Confirmation of key stakeholders involved or impacted by an initiative or solution
A succinct summary for an initiative or solution

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “PROBLEM SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Establish definitions for categories of stakeholders (organizational, operational, infrastructure)
Determine key stakeholders for each category
Determine a means for ensuring all key stakeholders are involved to an appropriate degree
Document any disclosed gaps to success

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “SOLUTION SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Verify ongoing relevance of the initiative or solution to key stakeholders
Verify initiative or solution is properly positioned for success as defined by each dimension and key stakeholder
List key takeaways (gaps, risks, actions, etc.)
